source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Locate the failed test specifications and the associated data on those test records.
3. Copy the failed test specification in the first column of the spreadsheet to be populated.
4. Lastly, copy and paste the failed test data in the corresponding column.

All failure reasons and their corresponding test data should be in the failed test specification section of the performance report. A supplemental section cannot be added to the report to get additional clarification. Do not place the test data in the conclusions part of the report. The product approval recommendation and conclusion should both accurately reference and reflect the failed tests. Each failure reason should have one and only one reason and corresponding test number that is documented with the test data.
